name: TrialMasterFileCompletenessTracker
tagline: Live eTMF completeness, QC and inspection readiness for every study, country and site.
description: A complete plug-and-play Power Apps app for clinical operations and QA: expected-vs-filed TMF artifacts by TMF Reference Model zone, filing timeliness, a four-eyes QC workflow, inspection-critical gaps, milestone tracking, a readiness score with documented readiness reviews and risk-based QC sampling for mock inspections. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages; demo data included.
features: Completeness (critical-weighted), timeliness and quality KPIs with a 0–100 readiness score
Zone × trial/country/site heat map with missing and QC-issue badges
13 quick filters, filter drawer, grouping, sorting, paging and bulk QC pass
QC board with enforced rules: document reference and dates, four-eyes QC, categorised findings, justified N/A, no N/A for critical artifacts
Milestone timeline with filing-lag histogram and next 30/60/90 days
Inspection readiness status with reasons, critical checklist and readiness reviews with override rules
Risk-based QC sample for mock inspections
Add site checklist: creates the expected site essential documents from the activation date
Undo, history, empty/loading/error/read-only states, keyboard and touch, phone layout
Power Fx outputs and events; optional direct Dataverse save; Power Pages Web API control
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
